scope: Canonical generation plan for every Defold script route and dmSDK runtime declaration. It describes emission decisions and marshalling only; it is not compile, link, runtime, allocation, or conformance evidence.

evidenceBoundary.generation: A backend selection of emit means the plan permits an emitter to produce source.
evidenceBoundary.implementationLanes: Generated implementation records are descriptive overlays. They never promote a backend selection or erase unresolved semantic tokens.

script-scalar-dispatch.scope: Generated scalar Lua descriptors and stable dispatch identities.

script-value-bindings.scope: Generated structured Defold-value operation descriptors and native adapters.

script-fixed-tuples.scope: Generated fixed-tuple codecs and target dispositions.

script-dynamic-values.scope: Generated dynamic-value candidate descriptors and focused native evidence.

script-value-tail.scope: Generated remaining Defold-value family descriptors and blockers.

script-overload-dispatch.scope: Generated overload classifiers and target dispositions.

script-table-records.scope: Generated fixed-record codecs and required-context claims.

script-callback-lifecycle.scope: Generated callback lifecycle contracts and registry eligibility.

script-url-dispatch.scope: Generated URL/address codecs and captured-instance dispatch identities.

dmsdk-scalar-thunks.scope: Generated scalar C ABI, target adapters, and staged verification claims.

dmsdk-enum-values.scope: Generated enum-domain value bindings and staged verification claims.

dmsdk-arena-span-blockers.scope: Generated explicit blockers for unresolved arena/span declarations.

script-handle-lowering.scope: Generated captured-Lua handle descriptors/router and target-specific evidence dispositions.

script-universal-value.scope: Generated bounded recursive Lua/JS value-graph descriptors and native Dynamic Hermes adapter.

dmsdk-cstring-value.scope: Generated private C-string ABI staging and target-specific registration/linkage dispositions.

dmsdk-borrowed-handle.scope: Generated borrowed-handle consumer provider boundary and explicit structural/semantic blockers.

script-projection-only.scope: Canonical ownership for script routes that have projection IR but no specialized generated adapter lane yet.

dmsdk-projection-only.scope: Canonical ownership for dmSDK declarations that have projection IR but no specialized generated adapter lane yet.
